stories.title: Flintshire roadworks: Green Lane, Wylfa Roundabout and Church Street in Flint among this week’s work
stories.summary: Green Lane in Ewloe is closed from today, Monday 23 November, until Friday 4 December for electricity works by O’Connor Utilities. stories.title: Flintshire Council adopts plan to modernise services after public consultation
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has signed off a three-year plan setting out how it will change the way its services are run, after making changes based on residents’ feedback. stories.title: HMRC warns of fake tax refund scams ahead of 31 January Self Assessment deadline
stories.summary: HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) is warning anyone filing a Self Assessment tax return to watch out for fake tax refund offers as the 31 January deadline gets closer. stories.title: Van seized on A55 at Dobshill with no insurance, no MOT and declared off road

stories.title: North Wales Fire and Rescue Authority seeks three members of the public for standards committee
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Authority is looking for three members of the public to sit on the committee that oversees how its members behave, with applications closing at noon on Monday. Flintshire County Council is recruiting one more for its own standards committee in the same campaign, and people can apply for either role
